mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "channel" looks up specific channel login(s). "by-game" discovers the top live channels in a game/category first, then looks up each one -- useful for finding sponsorship-outreach targets in a niche.

login.title: Channel login
login.description: "channel" mode -- a single Twitch channel login.

logins.title: Channel logins
logins.description: "channel" mode only -- multiple channel logins to look up in one run.

gameName.title: Game/category name
gameName.description: "by-game" mode -- the exact game/category name as it appears on Twitch (e.g. "Just Chatting", "League of Legends"). The top live channels in this category (by current viewer count) will be looked up.

limit.title: Max channels to check
limit.description: "by-game" mode only -- how many of the top live channels in the category to look up. Capped at 30 (Twitch's own per-page ceiling for this connection).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many channels to look up in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
